My First Reproducible Report (L2-6)

Descriptive Statistics Table

dat |> summarise(across(c(loneliness, depression), list(mean = mean, sd = sd))) |> knitr::kable(digits = 2)
loneliness_mean loneliness_sd depression_mean depression_sd
8.8 3.08 3.84 3.4

Two Plots

ggplot(dat, aes(loneliness, depression)) + geom_jitter(alpha = .3) + geom_smooth(method = "lm")

ggplot(dat, aes(depression)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1)

Interpretation

The correlation between loneliness and depression total scores is r = 0.31. Numbers come directly from code, and re-knitting after data updates refreshes them automatically—this is what “reproducible” means.
